t: Rocket TT 100ml cap and straw aerosol is a versatile maintenance fluid, expertly formulated for lubrication, water displacement, penetration, and corrosion protection. Ideal for workshops, garages, and construction sites, proving invaluable for mechanics, plumbers, and general tradespeople. Stops squeaks and lubricates moving elements, ensuring smooth operation. The maintenance fluid also penetrates and loosens corroded and seized nuts, bolts, and cables, simplifying disassembly tasks; can also be used to remove glue, pencil, and gum marks from most surfaces. Leaves a protective, water-resistant anti-corrosion coating, safeguarding components in temperatures ranging from -40 °C to 30 °C.
b: Penetrates & Loosens Corroded Nuts, Bolts & Cables
Removes Glue, Pencil & Gum Marks From Surfaces
Protects Metal Components Against Rust & Wear
Versatile Formula For Workshop & Site Applications
Easy Application With Convenient Aerosol Can
